stdout:
usage: nexus-instance.py [-h] [--events EVENTS] [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                         [--output OUTPUT] [--at AT]
                         {validate,plan,replay} instance

Deterministic NEXUS planner and event replay. Never executes a tool or agent.
All authority/evidence records are supplied assertions. The host must
authenticate and enforce them before live action. Replay validates contracts,
not truth.

positional arguments:
  {validate,plan,replay}
  instance

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --events EVENTS
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --output OUTPUT
  --at AT
